subject: Wizardly Health — Sales→CS Intake and Onboarding Sprint Plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Wizardly Health — Sales→CS Intake: overview and asks

Team,

Summary: Wizardly Health (health-tech marketplace) signed a Dedicated+Private deployment contract. ARR: $420k/year. Go-live target: 2026-09-15 (pilot with 2 clinics) -> full rollout Q4. Primary product uses: semantic search over clinical notes (embedding+rerank) and patient-facing assistant (chat) with strict PHI controls.

What we sold and constraints:
- Deployment: Private (VPC) in us-west-2, customer-managed VPC peering.
- Models: baseline generation + 1 embedding model; customer wants the 8k-context variant (we agreed to run a verified 8k-quantized build).
- Security: SOC2 required; they will need audit logs, customer-managed KMS, and optional bring-your-own-key (BYOK).
- SSO: Okta SAML; they will provide test accounts.

Key asks for CS:
1) Nominate PM and SE lead for the 4-week onboarding sprint and confirm owners by EOD Monday (08/10).
2) Schedule kickoff with Wizardly infra and product teams week of 08/11 (target Thu 08/12 10am PT).
3) Confirm network prerequisites: CIDR ranges, egress rules, and firewall contacts (Alec Ramos is infra lead).
4) Pre-kickoff checklist: SOC2 controls matrix (we'll send), SSO test user, sample dataset (anonymized up to 50 docs), and DocuSign-signed SOW (attached).

Risks to call out:
- VPC networking cadence: customer procurement requested a vendor security review; expect a 3-business-day approval for peering.
- Data classification: they treat clinical notes as sensitive; CS to validate retention and redaction choices before enabling export.

Attachments: Wizardly_SOW_v1.pdf, WZD_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (see links). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/WZD-2026-08

Notes for SE: anticipated peak qps ~80–120 req/s for embeddings during search spikes; batching profile will matter.

Thanks — please reply with owners and any scheduling constraints.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Thanks — will follow up with calendar invite.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Wizardly Health — Sales→CS Intake: overview and asks

Monica — quick technical notes for the kickoff and what I'll need from Wizardly:

1) Infra baseline
- GPUs: target a 2x g5.48xlarge-equivalent pool for Dedicated (we'll size down after pilot).
- Expected load: steady 20–30 req/s, spikes up to ~120 req/s on search bursts. Embedding batch size recommended 64; enable async prefix caching for chat sessions.

2) Networking
- Need customer CIDR block list and peering window; ask Alec for a contactable IP range + firewall owner.

3) Security & data
- BYOK KMS steps: provide key ARN and contact for KMS ops.
- Retention: confirm 30/90/365 day retention policy (they leaned to 90d).

4) Implementation details
- We'll deploy a quantized 8k model variant. Recommend starting with kv-cache warmup during off-hours.
- Sample curl for sandbox ingest (will paste in kickoff doc).

I'll raise SUP-4281 subtask for network ACL preflight and link to the JIRA board.

Bringing this up now so Monica can include these asks in the kickoff invite and the pre-kick checklist.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
